Title: General availability: Azure ExpressRoute: 5 New Peering Locations Available

Body.Content:
We are annoucing 5 new peering locations are now available for ExpressRoute:

  • Bogota
  • Madrid
  • Sao Paulo
  • Rio de Janeiro
  • Toronto2

With this announcement, ExpressRoute is now available across 75 global commercial Azure peering locations. For more information about peering locations and partnering service providers, visit the ExpressRoute Locations and Partners webpage.
